tweet.text:
Forgot to post Friday’s NYAM trade, so here it is 🦜

Caught the overnight long. Then waited for the pullback to do it again 😂

Overnight, the sweep below the previous day’s low and reclaim gave me the first long.

Then CPI gave us a fresh data range and a strong move higher.

I didn’t chase it.

Waited for the NY session pullback into the golden pocket, then hit the continuation long. More green.

I wasn’t trying to call the top just because price had rallied. I was waiting for my opportunity to get back with the move.

Bullish context. Defined range. Pullback into my area.

The entry matters just as much as getting the direction right.

Same Green Bird playbook. One opportunity at a time.

🦜 Calm Under Pressure.
